name: io.hibira.realtime
description: Realtime WebSocket channels for Unity on Hibira and other Pusher-compatible servers: public, private and presence channels, client events, game rooms (seats, host, ready, chat) and a matchmaking queue, shared with @hibira-io/lobby browser players. Works in WebGL builds.

samples.description: A room with seats, ready flags, chat and start, drawn with IMGUI. Drop LobbySample on an empty GameObject.
